text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet put on a great performance 
in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next goal is the Senior Class's first 
middle-distance Gâ : the Osaka Hai. Daiwa 
Scarlet is fired up to shine brighter than 
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Vodka, who was watching that run, also 
inwardly acknowledged her performance.
